description: This image displays a false-colour satellite image of a port area in Stockholm, Sweden, dated 2009, sourced from Eurostat's LUCAS (Land Use/Cover Area frame Survey). Vegetated areas appear in deep red, indicative of near-infrared spectral characteristics. Water bodies, including the sea or a large river, are depicted in black. Artificial surfaces, such as buildings, quays, piers, dockyards, and paved transport/storage areas associated with the port, are shown in shades of grey and light blue. A large, complex land area, identified as a port, is comprehensively delineated by a light blue polygon. Within this main delineated area, the numeric label "123" is visible. Several smaller, distinct polygons, also outlined in light blue, represent additional associated port facilities or land parcels. On the landward side, thin green and yellow dashed lines are visible, potentially representing roads or other linear infrastructure. This image illustrates the physical extent and components of a port area for land use/land cover (LULC) classification purposes.
